svg.title: Databricks Retail Analytics Architecture
svg.desc: Left-to-right data flow from PostgreSQL dump file through Databricks ingestion, catalog table, compute cluster, analytics notebook, to notebook results. GitHub repository connects to the analytics notebook via a dotted line.
svg.text: Data is ingested from a PostgreSQL dump, persisted as a managed Databricks table,
and analyzed using distributed PySpark workflows.
Retail analytics workflow migrated from single-machine Python to distributed Spark on Databricks
